# Zed Extension Safari

> Discover fresh Zed editor extensions, themes and language packs that are actively maintained but haven't gone viral yet. Updated every 6 hours.

This index lists 1598 Zed editor extensions discovered on GitHub. Each package page links to the GitHub repository and embeds the project's README. Data refreshes every 6 hours.

## Site

- [Homepage](https://helgesverre.github.io/gh-packages-zed/): Browse, search, and filter all 1598 packages
